episodes.title: 1. Bölüm
episodes.summary: A longtime fan of respected news anchor Lale Kıran, Aslı bluffs her way into an internship at Lale's office, determined to win the game.

episodes.title: 2. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Aslı sets traps for other interns but struggles to take down Güliz, whose connections protect her. Kenan invites a rival to Lale's party, riling Gül.

episodes.title: 3. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Kenan asks Yusuf to find the culprit behind the BüşBüş gossip account. Lale's at odds with her team after refusing to report on the yacht fire rumors.

episodes.title: 4. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Lale and Kenan ask Özge to fetch a USB drive with confidential news material, but Aslı has designs on it. Aslı causes tension between Selim and Lale.

episodes.title: 5. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Amid her scheme to rekindle the flame between Lale and Kenan, Aslı asks Yusuf to help spread gossip. Lale and Müge were once co-anchors.

episodes.title: 6. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Kenan surprises Lale with a heartfelt revelation. While Lale is live on TV, Aslı tries to sabotage her. Soon, Lale grows suspicious and makes her move.

episodes.title: 7. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Selim gives Lale an ultimatum — part ways with Kenan or risk ruining their marriage. Yusuf makes a pivotal decision. In a fury, Aslı confronts Lale.

episodes.title: 8. Bölüm
episodes.summary: After an unexpected meeting with Gül, Aslı convinces Müge to stage a mutiny to destroy Lale's credibility, but Lale's supporters speak up.

episodes.title: 1. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Aslı has everything she's ever wanted — but a higher profile comes with greater threats. Despite her best efforts, Lale struggles with life off camera.

episodes.title: 2. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Sparks fly as Lale goes back on air and Yusuf returns from the field. Aslı's new method of broadcasting yields sky-high ratings and damning results.

episodes.title: 3. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Unnerved by Aslı's continued success, Lale retaliates by digging into the truth behind the Ilayda case. Gül's attempts to consolidate power backfire.

episodes.title: 4. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Aslı's new alliance falls through as quickly as it was forged. Lale reminisces about the past as cracks begin to form in her present.

episodes.title: 5. Bölüm
episodes.summary: After a heated conversation, hard truths leave Lale and Aslı reeling. Güliz poaches Kenan; Selim's suspicions grow. Later, disaster strikes.

episodes.title: 6. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Lale's renewed zeal makes her ratings rise to the top, but the cost of success is steep. Aslı, unaware of a new player in her midst, unleashes on Müge.

episodes.title: 7. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Aslı puts two and two together, but her enemy has learned from the best: her. Struggling to adapt to her new life, Lale finds solace in helping others.

episodes.title: 8. Bölüm
episodes.summary: As pressure mounts and her ratings plummet, Aslı hits her breaking point. Lale turns the tables, sparking the dawn of a new era.

episodes.title: 1. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Lale is enjoying work outside of the mainstream media. Aslı's show is a huge success. When they each receive a tempting offer, how will they respond?

episodes.title: 2. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Gül tries to mediate between Lale, Kenan and their new CEO. Aslı confronts Yusuf, and they make plans to work more closely together.

episodes.title: 3. Bölüm
episodes.summary: An online threat against Lale triggers disastrous consequences, while her friends and colleagues are divided over who to blame and who to believe.

episodes.title: 4. Bölüm
episodes.summary: The culprit behind the scandal gets caught. News anchors on both channels struggle with whether to address the incident on the air.

episodes.title: 5. Bölüm
episodes.summary: After standing her ground on the show, Lale makes a decision which devastates Kenan. Müge finally comes close to achieving a long-held dream.

episodes.title: 6. Bölüm
episodes.summary: A furious Güliz makes Aslı a tempting offer in exchange for information about Yusuf. Lale gets a lesson in bravery from her daughter.

episodes.title: 7. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Lale and Aslı are finally working together — but to get the ratings they want, they need a new strategy. Müge starts to struggle under pressure.

episodes.title: 8. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Kenan makes a desperate plea to Lale. Güliz finally learns the truth about Aslı and Yusuf, who discover that love comes at a cost.
